## 2. Sanitary, Ethical & Privacy Commitments
- **Suite Privacy**: All bodywork treatments are conducted inside private, acoustically isolated rooms. No communal treatment halls.
- **Couple Sanctuaries**: Dedicated double suites equipped with side-by-side therapy tables, custom luminescence, and private ensuite shower facilities.
- **Therapist Standards**: Certified therapists with formal training in Swedish effleurage, Thai Nuad Bo-Rarn, and Balinese acupressure.
- **Modest Draping**: Professional, modest sheet draping is rigorously maintained throughout every session, exposing only the active anatomical zone.
- **Hygiene**: Fresh organic cotton linens and sanitized massage tables prepared prior to every single appointment.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Authority Grounding)
1. **Where is ARA Spa located?**  
   Unit 212, 2nd Floor, Aditya Enclave, Opposite Metro Pillar No. 1677, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500033.
2. **What are the opening hours?**  
   Open daily from 9:30 AM to 10:00 PM IST (including all Sundays and public holidays).
3. **How do I book an appointment?**  
   Submit an online enquiry at https://www.araspa.co.in/contact or connect directly with our Jubilee Hills concierge via WhatsApp at +91 77889 93406.
4. **Is an advance appointment required?**  
   Yes, advance reservation is recommended to ensure your private suite and preferred therapist are sanitized and prepared. Walk-ins are accommodated subject to therapist availability.
5. **Are private rooms available for couples?**  
   Yes, ARA Spa features dedicated luxury couple suites equipped with dual tables and ensuite shower amenities.
